svg.title: A piece table: the file and the add buffer never move; only the list of pieces changes

g.title: The file is opened by mapping it: nothing is read or copied. The text is one piece, orig 0+12: 12 bytes of the original, from its byte 0. The add buffer is empty.

"f" at byte 4: the byte goes on the end of the add buffer, at 0. The piece that byte 4 is inside is cut in two, orig 0+4 and orig 4+8, and a new piece, add 0+1, goes between them. Walked 1 piece to find the place.

a, t and a space: each goes on the end of the add buffer. The piece before the cursor ends at the end of the add buffer, so it only gets longer, to add 0+4: no new piece. Walked 3 pieces for each key.

"!" at byte 15: the byte goes on the end of the add buffer, at 4. The piece that byte 15 is inside is cut in two, orig 4+7 and orig 11+1, and a new piece, add 4+1, goes between them. Walked 3 pieces to find the place.
Backspace: erase byte 15. The piece add 4+1, the !, is taken out of the list. The ! itself stays where it is in the add buffer: no byte is ever taken out of a buffer. Walked 4.

"." at byte 15: it goes on the end of the add buffer, at 5. The piece before the cursor, orig 4+7, is not the end of the add buffer (the ! is), so it cannot grow: a new piece, add 5+1. The ! stays in the add buffer, in no piece.
